payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP where states are (number of 'a' characters placed, number of changes used) to maximize subsequence count of t='ab'.
payload.rationale: Solution uses DP with two dimensions tracking count of first character and changes; transitions consider setting each position to either a or b, updating cost and adding q-1 when setting to b. Classic DP for subsequence maximization with limited changes.
